company.name: GetInsured
company.shortDescription: Leading provider of SaaS-based exchanges for state-based health insurance marketplaces.
company.description: GetInsured is a leading technology provider for state-based exchanges, offering an ACA-compliant cloud-based SaaS technology platform and integrated consumer assistance center operations. GetInsured’s roster of clients includes Georgia, Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Nevada, California, Virginia, Minnesota, Idaho, and Washington. The award-winning SaaS platform processed enrollments for 2.7 million consumers for plan year 2023, which represents approximately two-thirds of all state-based marketplace enrollments.
